system.description:
You inscribe into your scroll the image of a rodent with wings and a long body, an odd mix of a bat and serpent infusing chakra into it as it exits your scroll into a space within range, summoning the Ink Bat/Snake. The Ink Bat/Snake has the listed statistics found on its stat block in the Summon Stat Blocks section.

You may command the Ink Bat/Snake as a bonus action on your turn. The Ink Bat/Snake may take an appropriate reaction if able, such as attack of opportunity. The Ink Bat/Snake uses your Ninjutsu Attack bonus for its attacks and your Save DC for all of its effects save DC’s.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3.
